pipelines.name: ci

steps.name: Build plugin bundle for e2e jobs
Run Playwright tests for ${{ matrix.shard.name }}
steps.run:
SPEC_OUTPUT="$(node ./scripts/ci-test-groups.mjs list "${{ matrix.shard.group }}")"
[[ -n "${SPEC_OUTPUT}" ]]
mapfile -t SPEC_FILES <<<"${SPEC_OUTPUT}"
npx playwright test --project=chromium "${SPEC_FILES[@]}"

if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "pull_request" ]; then
  echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
# The pull_request checkout is a merge commit; its first parent is the base.
changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD^1 HEAD)
if [ -n "$changed" ] && grep -qvE '^(webapp/|e2e/|docs/|loadtest/|assets/|img/)|\.md$' <<< "$changed"; then
  echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Find master baseline
steps.run:
run_id=""
repo="repos/${{ github.repository }}"
for id in $(gh api "$repo/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?branch=master&event=push&status=completed&per_page=20" --jq '.workflow_runs[].id'); do
  evals_ok=$(gh api "$repo/actions/runs/$id/jobs?per_page=100" \
    --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name | startswith("evals / evals-"))] | length > 0 and all(.conclusion == "success")')
  [ "$evals_ok" = true ] || continue
  artifacts=$(gh api "$repo/actions/runs/$id/artifacts?per_page=100" \
    --jq '[.artifacts[] | select(.expired == false and (.name | startswith("eval-results-")))] | length')
  if [ "$artifacts" -gt 0 ]; then
    run_id=$id
    break
  fi
done
echo "run-id=$run_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Build report
steps.run:
make evalviewer
./bin/evalviewer report \
  --results eval-results \
  --baseline eval-baseline \
  --providers openai,anthropic,azure,mistral,bedrock \
  --previous previous-comment.md \
  --comment comment.md \
  --summary summary.md \
  --commit "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}" \
  --run-url "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
cat summary.md >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Check editor contract against the pinned host snapshot
Upload dist to S3
steps.run: aws s3 cp dist/mattermost-ai-*.tar.gz s3://${{ secrets.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/mattermost-plugin-agents/mattermost-plugin-agents-${{ steps.short-sha.outputs.sha }}.tar.gz

steps.name: Update latest-master release
steps.run:
PLUGIN_FILE=$(ls dist/*.tar.gz)
# Get the commit message and hash
COMMIT_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B)
COMMIT_HASH=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)

# Delete the old release if it exists
gh release delete latest-master --yes || true

# Delete the old tag if it exists
git tag -d latest-master || true
git push origin :refs/tags/latest-master || true

# Create new tag and release
git tag latest-master
git push origin latest-master

gh release create latest-master \
  --title "Latest Master Build" \
  --notes "Latest build from master branch - ${COMMIT_HASH}" \
  --prerelease \
  $PLUGIN_FILE

steps.name: Deploy to Mattermost instances
steps.run:
PLUGIN_FILE=$(ls dist/*.tar.gz)
echo "Found plugin bundle: $PLUGIN_FILE"

echo "$MM_SERVERS_CONFIG" | jq -c '.[]' | while read -r server; do
  url=$(echo "$server" | jq -r '.url')
  token=$(echo "$server" | jq -r '.token')

  echo "Deploying to $url"
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" \
       -X POST \
       -F "plugin=@$PLUGIN_FILE" \
       -F "force=true" \
       "$url/api/v4/plugins"
done

pipelines.name: mcp-registry

steps.name: Check server.json invariants
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
jq -e '
  .name == "io.github.mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents"
  and (.description | length >= 1 and length <= 100)
  and (.version | test("^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"))
  and ((.packages // []) | length == 0)
  and (.remotes | length == 1)
  and .remotes[0].type == "streamable-http"
  and .remotes[0].url == "https://{mattermost_host}/plugins/mattermost-ai/mcp-server/mcp"
  and (.remotes[0].variables | keys == ["mattermost_host"])
  and .remotes[0].variables.mattermost_host.isRequired == true
  and ([(.remotes[0].headers // [])[] | {name, value, isSecret}] == [{"name": "Authorization", "value": "Bearer {personal_access_token}", "isSecret": true}])
  and (.remotes[0].headers[0].variables | keys == ["personal_access_token"])
  and .remotes[0].headers[0].variables.personal_access_token.isSecret == true
  # Every input stays user-supplied: a preset value, default or
  # choices list would let a client fill in the host or token.
  and ([.. | objects | select(has("variables")) | .variables[] | has("value") or has("default") or has("choices")] | any | not)
' server.json >/dev/null || {
  echo "::error file=server.json::server.json must keep the canonical name, remote URL and Authorization header, user-supplied inputs only (no value, default or choices), no packages, a description of at most 100 characters, and a plain x.y.z version."
  exit 1
}

pipelines.name: nightly-evals

steps.name: Build report
steps.run:
make evalviewer
./bin/evalviewer report \
  --results eval-results \
  --baseline eval-baseline \
  --providers openai,anthropic,azure,mistral,bedrock \
  --comment regressions.md \
  --summary summary.md \
  --json summary.json \
  --change-label "this run" \
  --baseline-label "the previous night" \
  --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --run-url "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"

steps.name: Store results in S3
steps.run:
dest="$EVALS_S3/$HISTORY_KIND/$(date -u +%F)/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
aws s3 cp eval-results "$dest/" --recursive
aws s3 cp summary.json "$dest/summary.json"
aws s3 cp summary.md "$dest/summary.md"
# Only providers that produced results replace their baseline, so a
# night with a provider outage keeps that provider's last good one.
# The eval jobs never fail on eval results, so a failed matrix means
# a job timed out or was cancelled and its results may be partial.
if [ "$HISTORY_KIND" = nightly ] && [ "${{ needs.evals.result }}" = success ]; then
  for p in $(jq -r '.providers[] | select(.available) | .name' summary.json); do
    results="eval-results/eval-results-$p/evals.jsonl"
    if [ -f "$results" ]; then
      aws s3 cp "$results" "$EVALS_S3/nightly/latest/eval-results-$p/evals.jsonl"
    fi
  done
fi

steps.name: Build trend
steps.run:
aws s3 cp "$EVALS_S3/$HISTORY_KIND/" eval-history --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*/summary.json'
./bin/evalviewer trend --history eval-history --limit 14 > trend.md
{
  if [ -s regressions.md ]; then cat regressions.md; echo; fi
  cat summary.md
  echo
  cat trend.md
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Fail on regressions
steps.run:
if [ -s regressions.md ] && [ -n "$(ls -A eval-baseline 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo "::error title=Nightly eval regressions::Checks newly fail compared with the previous night. See the run summary."
  exit 1
fi
